select a.id assetId, a.name assetName, a.ip assetIp1, a.ip2 assetIp2, a.desk assetDesk, a.NTP_FLAG, m.name deskName, o.id orgId, r.id roomId, r.name roomName, o.title orgName, t.id cabinetId, case when c.cabinet_id is not null then (t.name || ' ' || c.START_POSITION || '-' || c.END_POSITION || 'U') end cabinetName from asset a left join asset_mode m on a.desk = m.code left join asset_attach c on a.id = c.asset_id left join sys_org o on a.org_id = o.id left join room r on c.room_id = r.id left join cabinet t on c.cabinet_id = t.id where a.is_del = 1 and a.watch = 1 and a.id in
#{id}
SELECT ASSET_ID AS ID, ASSET_NAME AS NAME, MAX(INSPECT_STATE) AS STATUS FROM INSPECT_ASSET WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} GROUP BY ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME ORDER BY ASSET_ID
SELECT ASSET_DESK, DESK_NAME, EVENT_TYPE_ID, EVENT_TYPE_NAME FROM INSPECT_ASSET WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} GROUP BY ASSET_DESK, DESK_NAME, EVENT_TYPE_ID, EVENT_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY EVENT_TYPE_ID
SELECT ASSET_DESK AS ID, DESK_NAME AS NAME FROM INSPECT_ASSET WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} GROUP BY ASSET_DESK, DESK_NAME ORDER BY ASSET_DESK
SELECT i.*, t.EVENT_CATEGORY FROM INSPECT_ASSET i LEFT JOIN ALARM_EVENT_TYPE t ON i.EVENT_TYPE_ID = t.ID WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} ORDER BY i.ASSET_ID, i.ASSET_DESK

SELECT EVENT_TYPE_ID AS ID, EVENT_TYPE_NAME AS NAME, MAX(INSPECT_STATE) AS STATUS, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN INSPECT_STATE = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL, SUM(CASE WHEN INSPECT_STATE = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ABNORMAL FROM INSPECT_ASSET WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} GROUP BY EVENT_TYPE_ID, EVENT_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY EVENT_TYPE_ID

SELECT INSPECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, TARGET_ITEM, TARGET_NAME, INSPECT_STATE, THRESHOLD_VALUE, INSPECT_VALUE, RESULT_MSG FROM INSPECT_DETAIL WHERE INSPECT_CODE = #{inspectRecordId} AND EVENT_TYPE_ID = #{eventTypeId} AND INSPECT_STATE = 5 ORDER BY ASSET_ID
